name: Genesis Plus GX
author: Eke-Eke
description_short: Accurate Sega 8/16-bit emulator: Genesis/Mega Drive, Sega CD, Master System, Game Gear, SG-1000.
description_long: Genesis Plus GX is an enhanced port of Charles MacDonald's Genesis Plus emulator, focused on accuracy and portability. Supports Sega Genesis/Mega Drive, Sega/Mega CD, Master System, Game Gear, and SG-1000, including unlicensed and pirate dumps with backwards-compatibility modes. ROM loading from SD cards via libfat (SD Gecko and SD2SP2).
